serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I just got on my phone a set of coordinates…
This must be the message from the Admin that I was waiting for.
Today is the day I will make probably the biggest choice of my life…
Let’s check it out on the internet where it is exactly.
It’s a bar quite far away. I will need to get on a bus.
It’s not a place I would usually visit on my own.
If I remember correctly I went there a few times with my colleagues from college.
Now that I think about it, none of them reached out to me when I dropped out, but that’s not important right now!
As Big Daddy said, it’s a public place and there’s quite a lot of people there. I should be relatively safe.
…At least I hope so…
